name: io.github.codeyoc/repairdesk-mcp
title: RepairDesk MCP Server
description: MCP server giving AI assistants access to the RepairDesk API — tickets, customers, invoices, inventory, employees, and shop reference data.

environmentVariables.name: REPAIRDESK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your RepairDesk API key (Settings > API in your RepairDesk admin)

environmentVariables.name: REPAIRDESK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the RepairDesk API base URL (defaults to https://api.repairdesk.co/api/web/v1)
